## Highest‑Priority Open Items (Weight ≥ 0.65)
| # | Item | What to Do | Deadline |
|---|------|------------|----------|
| 1 | **Integrate MemGPT‑style virtual‑context paging** to reduce interference at ≥ 40 items. | Prototype a paging layer that stores older facts externally and restores them on demand. | **Day 22** (Mon, May 20) – preliminary design + GPU budget estimate. |
| 2 | **Add periodic consolidation** (summary compression) to the naive‑append baseline. | Encode a compression routine that triggers every 20 facts; compare QA accuracy to rewrite baseline. | **Day 24** (Wed, May 22) – first A/B run. |
| 3 | **Workshop paper benchmark scope** – ensure ablation (rewrite vs append) is part of the evaluation suite. | Draft benchmark spec that includes naive‑append (MemGPT paging) and bounded‑memory + consolidation. | **Day 19** (Thu, May 18) – data schema ready. |

### Suggested Draft Response
- *Draft: Maya – thank you for the rough outline. I’ll review the sections on benchmark design and the naive‑append baseline and get back to you by Wednesday. Happy to coordinate a short call if needed.*

## Overnight Idea
> **Combine MemGPT virtual paging with periodic consolidation** to keep the active context under the token budget while preserving (or improving) QA accuracy beyond the 40‑fact threshold.
